messages.subject: [Ipmpack-users] survival and growth objects incorporating a random effect
messages.subject_clean: [Ipmpack-users] survival and growth objects incorporating a random effect
messages.body_plain:
I am using IPMpack to model a tropical tree species. 

For my data, a linear model (to represent growth) and a logistic model (to represent survival) would both be improved by adding a random effect. The survival and growth models: MakeGrowthObj and MakeSurvObj call lm (linear model) and glm (logistic models) respectively. I am wondering if there are any survival or growth functions already written for IPMpack that call lmer and glmer. 

Thanks in advance for your response.

Best,
Christie

Christie Klimas
DePaul University 
Department of Environmental Science & Studies

messages.subject_clean: [Ipmpack-users] survival and growth objects incorporating a random effect
messages.body_plain:
Hi Christie!

I don't think there are any MakeGrowthObj and MakeSurvObj specifically 
for mixed effects models. But you can easily coerce the coef's (fixef or 
coefs for the random groups) into the lm/glm-based objects from IPMpack. 
Just make 'templates' of the same fixed effect structure as in your 
mixed effects models, and then overwrite the lm/glm-coefs with your 
values (in the growthObj also sigma can be changed). I think for survObj 
and growthObj there's coerce-functions written in IPMpack, but for 
clonalObj or fecObj you need to do it "manually".

Cheers,
Joachim
